source_summaries.ncfrp_v51: This dataset focuses on social services, substance abuse history, criminal background, disability status, and other demographic information related to caregivers and biological parents involved in child fatalities. It does not contain any variables that directly or indirectly measure microglia activation, cell death, glutamatergic transmission, or hypoglossal motor nucleus activity.
